additionalRunsRule: Written before any further run was recorded (2026-11-10, tip ca1241142a): Node is recorded again with this recorder unchanged, one run at a time (--runs 1 --out <own folder>), the 5 runs already in runs.json counting toward the total. Recording stops as soon as both of these states have each been seen in some Node run, or at 30 runs in total, whichever comes first: (1) term_ph2a in `order`, around non-output entry 30 (its `running`): the echo frame (Write-Output MIXDOG_PH2_DONE) sent, then `running`, then a frame starting with \e[m; (2) term_ph2a in `order`, between non-output entries 43 (`running`) and 44 (`finished`): a resize re-render frame that does not contain the typed command (MIXDOG_PH2_SETTLE_1). Every run recorded is kept in runs.json in recording order; none is dropped or picked. Added before recording again (tip 8595ee0367, 23 runs, both states above seen: (1) in run 22, (2) in runs 6, 8, 14): a third state, from the replay after the core's fixes in 79be19874e: (3) term_ph2_l2 in `claims.order`, in the stretch between non-output entries 29 (termWrite) and 30 (its `running`): the typed command drawn whole in one state (`\e[93mWrite-Output \e[37mMIXDOG_PH2_SETTLE_1`, no line break, the pen left at colour 37) as the stretch's only state, `running` next, then a frame starting `\e[m\r\n`. Recording goes on, one run at a time with the recorder unchanged, until a run shows (3) or the runs number 30 in total, whichever comes first. Added before recording again (30 runs, (3) not shown; the core's delivery of that step traced equal to Node's: one 33-byte write with its \r, after the resize and its repaint): 20 more runs, one at a time, with the recorder as committed with this note (its hash in each run's manifest), stopping early if a run shows (3); 50 runs at most.

disposalPairEvidence: The comparison (remote-protocol-terminal-compare.mjs) takes a running/null pair after a dispose answer out only on the PowerShell tabs of its allow-list and only where the runs in runs.json vary at that disposal: some run has the pair there and some does not, and the trace must then have one of the runs' values (absent, or present at the same entries), held together with its other choices (consistentPlaces). Where every run has it at the same entries the trace must too; where none has it the trace may not. The mechanism (PSConsoleHostReadLine C marker against the console close) is why only those tabs are allowed; the recorded variance is what each exemption rests on.
framingProof: apps/mobile/fixtures/relay-framing drives Node's relay lane (remote-relay-push-lanes.ts) with a scripted source on a virtual clock: given output and activity changes at set times, Node's frames, their times and their order against the changes (G15 against G16/G17: a write and its change 15 ms after a frame go change first, 16 or 17 ms after it frame first). mixdog-spawn service::relay_buffer the_frames_are_nodes_for_the_recorded_script feeds the same steps to the core's RelayBuffer, the buffer the feed pump uses. The core's ordering of a change after its chunk is in the relay buffer is shown by mixdog-spawn terminal::lock_order tests (a_marker_change_waits_for_the_pump_to_take_its_chunk, the_pump_counts_from_its_first_event_after_an_evicted_prefix, a_paused_producers_chunk_changes_nothing_until_it_enters_the_feed, the_tabs_end_follows_the_output_before_the_exit, an_eviction_while_the_pump_subscribes_does_not_end_it, the_tabs_end_goes_between_the_output_before_the_exit_and_the_exit_line, a_shells_end_during_a_claim_waits_for_the_pump_to_reach_the_exit_line) and service::feeds output_written_right_after_a_claims_cut_is_held. Not proved by any recording: that the core's PTY reader hands the relay the same chunks at the same times node-pty did (the reader's cuts and timing against ConPTY); the real replay compares the states that output produces, not its cuts.

settled: Output no answered call causes (a resize re-render, a prompt after idle, a closing output against the next dispose) is waited for before the next call: its place among later calls is call latency, 0 ms in this in-process recorder and a socket round trip for a phone. The immediate part keeps the answer-ordered sequences (ensure then first output, dispose then closing output) unsettled.
comparisonEvidence: The comparison's stated level of evidence (remote-protocol-terminal-compare.mjs, consistentPlaces). Where Node's runs differ at a place (a state, an entry, a sequence of states, an order of tabs, an exit code, a disposal pair's presence and place, or a change's order against its own frame), the replay's trace is held to two things: (1) at every such place its alternative is one that some Node run shows, whole; (2) for every two such places, its two alternatives are shown together by at least one Node run. Combinations of three or more places are not checked: fifty runs cannot show three or more places varying jointly, and no finite number of runs could for all of them. A trace can therefore pass with a combination of three or more alternatives that no single run shows, provided every two of them occur together in some run.
